title: console marketplace: a soft-uninstalled package (status disabled) still shows Installed with no reinstall; listInstalledPackages drops status/enabled
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate ①: a product defect, measured on a local hosted-path stack (control plane plus an objectos runtime environment, with the Console built at framework `fa74b489`). The measurement is on the cloud side; the defect is in the Console.

## What happens

After a package is uninstalled on a hosted environment, the marketplace card still says "Installed" and offers no install or reinstall button.

The cloud side behaves correctly:
- Uninstall is a soft disable that keeps the installation row, for the ADR-0025 consent record and the sample-data state.
- `GET /cloud-connection/installation` answers `installed: false`.
- `GET /cloud-connection/installed` lists the row with `status: 'disabled'` and `enabled: false`. The SDK's `packages.list` / `enable` depend on that row being listed.
- Reinstalling through `POST /cloud-connection/install` answers 200, outcome `reinstalled`, and re-enables the same row.

## Cause (read at fa74b489, same on main 23d1303d)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts` `listInstalledPackages()` (around lines 942–967) maps every row and drops `status` and `enabled`.
- `MarketplacePage.tsx` (around lines 396–399) counts every listed row as installed.

## Ask

- The marketplace reads `status` / `enabled`, and does not count a disabled row as installed.
- It shows either the Install button, or 已停用 with a 重新安装 action that calls the install door, which re-enables the row.
- Setup → Packages reads the same list through `readMarketplaceInstalls()` and probably has the same gap (not measured). Please check it too.

## Business reason

A customer who uninstalls an app cannot see that it is off and cannot get it back. Today the only way out is a different package.

## Reader

The Console marketplace owner, through objectstack triage. No cloud change is needed. The cloud card that measured this closes when this one lands and the pin carries it.

## Dedup

Searched open and closed objectstack issues for "marketplace uninstall disabled installed reinstall": no card about the disabled state on the card.
